name: Shinto
summary: The kami traditions of the Japanese archipelago.

editorial_note.body: Organised at launch into Shrine, Sect and Folk Shinto.

founded.display: No founding; kami worship from prehistory
founded.note: Institutionalized in the 7th-8th centuries CE; practice long predates it

adherents.contested_note: Shinto adherence is contested by definition. Shrine-affiliation registers count roughly 80 to 90 million; self-identification surveys yield a few percent of Japan's population. Both positions stand; neither is "the" number.
